d:
Ek beghar larka… jo bana bharat ka pahla Emperor.
Yah hai Chandragupta Maurya ki puri, untold kahani — jo fiction se bhi zyada powerful hai.
Chandragupta Maurya koee rajkumar nahin tha.
Vah hara, apmanit huaa, aur history se mita diya gaya — lekin phir vapas aaya Chanakya ki strategy, Arthashastra ki planning, aur apni intelligence ke satha.
Is complete historical documentary men aap janenge:
Chandragupta Maurya ka rahasyamay birth aur early life
Takshashila men education aur first failure
Chanakya ki secret strategies aur Arthashastra
